task: write a word counting library in C++
reasons: a one-function library: one tester item, one developer item

card.contract: std::size_t wc::countWords(const std::string& text), declared in include/wc/wc.hpp and defined in src/wc.cpp. A word is a maximal run of characters that are not whitespace; space, tab and newline are whitespace. Returns 0 for an empty or all-whitespace string. Never throws.
acceptance: at least 5 tests, each checking one behaviour
